lastResponse.text: You’re doing the right thing by asking again. The number is nine one one — that’s nine, one, one. If you feel like you might act on that thought, call nine one one now. If you can stay safe, call your OB or hospital triage right away about the heavier bleeding and what you shared. I can stay with you while you make the call.
originalTexts: You’re doing the right thing by asking again. The number is **9-1-1** — that’s **nine, one, one**. If you feel like you might act on that thought, call **9-1-1 now**. If you can stay safe, call your OB or hospital triage right away about the heavier bleeding and what you shared. I can stay with you while you make the call.
